events.title: AECOM Stock Up as Q2 Earnings Beat Estimates, Backlog Increases Y/Y
events.body: ACM beats Q2 estimates as backlog hits record highs and FY26 profit guidance rises on strong execution and pipeline growth.

events.title: Fluor Q1 Earnings & Revenues Miss Estimates, Stock Down
events.body: FLR's Q1 2026 EPS and revenues miss estimates as legal and project charges hit results, sending shares down 15.2% on Friday.

events.title: Innodata Q1 Earnings & Revenues Top Estimates, 2026 Sales View Up
events.body: INOD beats Q1 2026 EPS and revenue estimates as AI data-service volumes surge; shares jump after hours and 2026 sales growth guidance is raised.

events.title: Jacobs Q2 Earnings & Revenues Top Estimates, Up Y/Y, FY26 View Raised
events.body: J tops Q2 estimates as EPS jumps 22% and backlog hits a record $27B, then lifts FY26 outlook again on broad demand.
